sources.title: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator — 2K Video, Native Audio
sources.snippet: What is MiniMax H3? MiniMax H3 is a general-purpose multimodal AI video model. It understands text, images, video, and audio as one creative context, then generates 2K audiovisual video with native stereo sound. Use a prompt alone, control the opening and ending with frames, or combine references to guide characters, products, motion, camera language, voice, style, and editing rhythm.

sources.title: MiniMax H3 Multimodal AI Video Model | Hailuo AI
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a new-generation, general-purpose multimodal video model. Instead of treating generation, editing, and reference tasks as separate workflows, H3 understands text, images, video, and audio as one creative context and turns that combined intent into coherent audiovisual content.
